answer: Nonce-bound work receipts: each identity must submit a solved challenge whose nonce derives from the prior receipt plus its own registration hash, forming an unbroken chain. A raven call signs the genesis block for each cohort. Every new identity must extend a distinct vine of verified parents, and the chain is sealed at dawn each epoch, invalidating unanchored branches. An attacker pays a fresh compute cost per identity and cannot replay receipts across branches, since each nonce is unrepeatable.
